title: 약국에서 증상 말하고 약 사기
summary: A short conversation at a Korean pharmacy: a customer without a prescription describes cold symptoms, answers the pharmacist's questions and learns how to take the medicine.
objective: Learners can say their symptoms (머리가 아파요 / 열이 나요 / 콧물이 나요), answer the pharmacist's questions (처방전 있으세요? 언제부터 아프셨어요? 알레르기 있으세요?), and understand '하루 세 번, 식후 30분에 드세요'.

task.title: Buy medicine at a pharmacy
task.line: You have had a fever and a runny nose since yesterday. Tell the pharmacist your symptoms, answer their questions, and repeat back how to take the medicine.

exercises: The pharmacist asks: '처방전 있으세요?' You don't have one. Answer in Korean.
The pharmacist asks: '언제부터 아프셨어요?' You started feeling sick this morning (오늘 아침). Answer in Korean.
The pharmacist asks: '알레르기 있으세요?' You are allergic to aspirin (아스피린). Answer in Korean.
The pharmacist says: '하루 세 번, 식후 30분에 드세요.' In English: how often and when do you take it?
The pharmacist asks: '어디가 아파서 오셨어요?' You have a headache and a runny nose. Answer in Korean.
answers: Three times a day, 30 minutes after each meal.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. What brings you in? (Where does it hurt?)
I have a headache and a fever.
Since when have you been sick?
Since yesterday evening. My nose is running a little too.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 이 감기약 드세요. 하루 세 번, 식후 30분에 드세요.
dialogue.meaning: Then take this cold medicine. Take it three times a day, 30 minutes after meals.

words.exampleMeaning: My child had a fever during the night.
Can I buy this without a prescription?
Since when has your throat been sore?
Should I take it 30 minutes after eating?
